objective: Prevent assistant-created cleanup residue by requiring lifecycle preflight before creating temporary external resources: verify cleanup capability first, prefer reuse/local isolation when cleanup is unavailable, and never create disposable residue silently. Preserve architecture isolation, mutation permissions, rollback provenance, and existing verification paths.

roles_before.artifact: PROTOCOL.md executes safe authorized tool-owned work and read-backs instead of handing it to Ron.
Architecture Mode isolates changes on a non-main candidate branch before promotion.
System engineering uses the smallest valid CI/read-back path and avoids unnecessary operational overhead.
External live mutations still require the authority defined by PROTOCOL.md and the exact task.
Git history and the recorded base SHA preserve the pre-change workflow.

role_dispositions.destination: Authorized execution remains assistant-owned, with an added lifecycle preflight before temporary external resource creation and an explicit incomplete-state rule when cleanup remains blocked.

Candidate isolation remains mandatory, but when branch deletion is unavailable Architecture Mode reuses an already-clean candidate lane at the exact base instead of creating another disposable branch.
The fast path gains a resource-lifecycle preflight: verify cleanup before create; otherwise reuse a designated clean resource, use local/transactional isolation, or block rather than leak residue.
Lifecycle preflight does not widen mutation authority; exact external writes remain permission-gated as before.
Base SHA 3c21be7cdf3b0fdfb26f3afd233df54989a3c5fa remains the complete pre-change rollback point.

capability_probes.assertion: A genuinely temporary resource may still be created when deletion/cleanup capability is verified before creation and required isolation cannot be achieved more cheaply.
If cleanup is unavailable and no reusable/local isolation path exists, a new disposable external resource is denied unless Ron explicitly accepts the persistent residue before creation.
Quest lifecycle, Neon player state, PWA behavior, shop, achievements, attributes, notification logic and mutation permissions remain unchanged.
The pre-change workflow is recoverable at base SHA 3c21be7cdf3b0fdfb26f3afd233df54989a3c5fa.

tests.expected: Temporary creation is allowed only with verified cleanup, an intentional reusable resource, or explicit pre-accepted residue; blocked cleanup defaults to deny/reuse.
PASS; no change to player data, production schema, quest semantics or live mutation permissions.
